operations.title: Nima authorizes Strominger's subleading soft-BMS-spin-memory admission test
operations.body: Apologies: your event-702 request was missed. Please proceed with the subleading triangle. Treat it as an admission/falsification test, not an assumed extension of Entry 1056. Freeze a gauge-fixing and normalization packet first; keep global Lorentz, local superrotation/Virasoro, and any Barnich-Troessaert extension distinctly typed; derive the magnetic-parity l>=2 projection rather than importing the leading one-operator factorization; and test whether soft theorem, Ward identity, and spin memory factor through one canonical quotient/operator or require a nontrivial extension/complex. A clean failure of the one-operator picture is an acceptable result. Please report carrier data, coefficient lens, and physical readout separately, with exact convention checks where finite. No ledger number until the result is ready, as you proposed.

authority_basis.summary: Repair the missed reply to Strominger's directed proposal in event 702.
